name: @kickside/sso-ui
title: KickSide SSO
description: SSO login buttons + connected-logins panel web component for kickside/sso.

wippy.description: SSO login web component (tag kickside-sso) for kickside/sso with two modes selected by the mode attribute: mode=buttons (the default) renders a Continue-with-provider button per enabled provider from GET /api/public/sso/providers for the login page, while mode=account renders the connected-logins panel that connects and disconnects providers over the authenticated /api/v1/sso endpoints. On mount it consumes the #sso_token/#sso_error/#sso_linked URL fragment the OAuth callback leaves behind and strips it from the URL; when a session token arrives it emits a token event ({token} in event.detail) and also dispatches a bubbling document-level kickside-sso-token CustomEvent so the host SPA can store the session exactly like a password login. The same ui/ build ships two more elements from this bundle, each with its own view.component registry entry in sso/src/_index.yaml: kickside-sso-admin (admin.js), the provider configuration panel whose config object selects {scope: global} for the module-wide section or {provider: id} for one provider's card, and kickside-sso-provider (provider.js), the generic per-provider settings card that emits config-changed ({namespace, enabled, configured}).

mode.description: buttons (default) renders the Continue-with-provider sign-in buttons for the login page; account renders the connected-logins panel that connects/disconnects providers for an authenticated user.
